resources.string: Your songs never leave your phone. Ampli sends only a random app ID, purchases, app version, phone model, country, how you found the app, and any report you choose to send. We use it for support, checking purchases, stopping fraud and making Ampli better. Nothing is sold.
Quote this ID when you write to support@ampliapps.in to see or delete your data.
